reviewer: Kimi main recovery executor actually viewed the exact source and NEAREST 8x detail, complete unchanged current raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa reference; compared strict profile, frame, note groups and tab, and verified evidence/source/output/task/prompt/request/result/sheet bindings with read-only Python.

remaining_reasons: The source has TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in its upper note row and TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in its lower row. External-06 instead shows four repeated blobs in the upper row and three in the lower row. Restore exactly TWO source-scale separated irregular groups in EACH of those two rows, with the original relative lengths and compact footprint. Do not use generic repeated dots or readable writing; keep the blank lower paper and distinct small right-edge tab.

hair_features.reason: The high bald crown, short dark side/back hair and sideburn, one visible dark brow and clean-shaven chin remain.

collar_fit.reason: The high collar fits a short broad neck without a stalk, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib.

entries.positive_observation: The strict single-eye left profile is restored, with green-ringed black eyes, one serious mouth and short side/back hair. The olive uniform retains pale collar patches, neck cross, shoulder braid and note-clipped breast decorations. The complete tilted photo frame, small dark note tab and largely blank lower paper remain. White/cyan/alpha comparisons show genuine exterior transparency and no visible interior hole or lost backing.
entries.alpha_decision: The native exterior and frame/tab silhouette are compatible with the source, and near-opacity is not itself a rejection ground. The note's repeated blob groups nevertheless differ from the source's two-plus-two separated gray groups, so this is rejected for the RGB note defect rather than approved for production or alpha-only repair.
entries.visible_limitations: Possible tiny eyewear/temple details, individual breast decorations and note glyph identities cannot be resolved at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The rejection is for the clearly visible four-plus-three repeated blobs replacing the source's two-plus-two groups.
